name: Pho-Flavored French Dip Beef Sandwiches with Hoisin Mayo, Cilantro & Jalapeño

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
½ small bunch cilantro
1 jalapeño pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and halve onion. Peel and halve ginger.

Once the pot is hot, place the onion and ginger cut-side down in the pot. Cook, turning occasionally, until dark brown and charred, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve pot for later use, wiping it clean if necessary.)
Meanwhile, peel and lightly crush garlic.
Return pot to medium-low heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly toasted and fragrant, 30-60 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
2 star anise, whole
1 cinnamon stick
1 tsp coriander seeds
1 tsp fennel seeds

instructions.primary_message: Return charred onion and ginger to the pot along with broth, water, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar; stir to combine and bring to a simmer over high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until au jus is slightly thickened and flavors blend, about 30 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cups beef broth
2 tbsp fish sauce
2 tsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat beef dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
907 g tri-tip beef roast
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the roast and sear, turning every 2-3 minutes, until browned on all sides. Transfer roast to a clean plate.
Preheat oven to 325°F.
When the au jus is done, using a mesh strainer, strain into a measuring jug or medium bowl. Place the seared beef in the pot, then add strained broth and cover with a lid.
Place pot in the preheated oven and braise, turning roast occasionally, until beef is very tender, 1 1/2-2 hours.
When the beef is done, transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 10 minutes.
While the beef is resting, place mayo and hoisin sauce in a small bowl, then stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp hoisin sauce

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and place the leaves in a small bowl.

Thinly slice jalapeño pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the bowl with the cilantro. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Thinly slice beef against the grain.
Split and toast rolls (if desired).
Spread rolls with hoisin mayo, then fill with beef, cilantro, and jalapeño. Transfer to plates and serve with cups of the au jus on the side for dipping. Enjoy!
